messages:
Maria: quick Q — where do I find logs for Acme's private VPC deployment? specifically need a saved search that filters by org=acme, model=gen-xl, route=vpc-gen-1, region=ap-sg and status 5xx. trying to troubleshoot a spike during their canary rollout.

Leo: try the eng-observability dashboard > Private Deployments view. there�s a saved search called `private:vpc:routes` but it's pretty broad. you can paste this KQL into the Logs explorer: 

```
service:inference AND attributes.vpc_id:"vp-03a1b2c" AND org.id:"acme" AND model.name:"gen-xl" AND route.id:"vpc-gen-1" AND region:"ap-sg" AND response.status:[500 TO 599]
```

It should return the 5xx spikiness. link: https://observability.redwood.company/app/logs#/view/private-deployments

Maria: perfect, thanks. do we have a savedsearch that already combines those exact fields that I can share with the Acme CS rep? don't want to give them a wildcard view.

OpsBot: Saved search found: `acme_private_vpc_genxl_5xx` (id: ss-8f4a). You can share with `read-ops` or `acme-support` teams. Import/clone via CLI: 

```
obs-cli savedsearch clone --id ss-8f4a --team acme-support
```

Permissions: acme-support needs `logs:read` on org scope.

Ana: quick note on alerting — if this is a canary, we probably want an alert on 5xx rate but with a short mute window during rollout. recommendation: 5xx rate > 0.75% sustained for 10m, then auto-mute for 30m when `deployment.tag:canary` is present.

Jordan: +1. also suggest adding a percentile latency alert (p95 > 600ms) for that route. can add both to the `acme-private-slo` alert policy. alert link: https://observability.redwood.company/alerts/policies/acme-private-slo

Sam: For reproducibility, here's a quick savedsearch JSON snippet you can paste in the UI import: 

```
name: acme_private_vpc_genxl_5xx
query: service:inference AND org.id:"acme" AND model.name:"gen-xl" AND route.id:"vpc-gen-1" AND region:"ap-sg" AND response.status:[500 TO 599]
indices: [logs-*]
retention_days: 30
```

Maria: awesome. I'll import that and share with CS. one more: where do traces live for private routes? want to correlate a few 5xxs with spans.

Leo: traces are in the APM > Private Traces view. use span attribute `route.id` and `vpc_id`. there's a saved dashboard `apm/private-vpc-traces` that links to the logs savedsearch.

Maria: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Jordan: ping me once you share with CS and if you want I can add the mute logic to the alert policy (can do as a short rollout exception).

Maria: will do. tagging this thread in the ticket: TICKET-4821.
